name: zsys_detect_is_80386_by_ac_flag
description: zSys::DetectIs80386ByAcFlag toggles the EFLAGS AC bit to distinguish 80386-class behavior from later CPUs.
known_limits: The runtime smoke runs on a CPUID-capable host and does not force the no-CPUID fallback branch; exact VC byte evidence supplies the helper-body equivalence.
tier_s_evidence: VC5SP3 cl 11.00.7022 x86 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 /DRECOIL_ENABLE_ZSYS_CPU_RAW_ASM /FAcs COFF byte comparison for ?DetectIs80386ByAcFlag@zSys@@YAHXZ at 0x4b35f0 passed with zero unmasked mismatches after COFF relocation masking.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b35f0 validates stack alignment, EFLAGS AC-bit toggle, return of 3 when AC cannot change and 0xffff otherwise, EFLAGS restoration, and SP restoration.
Native smoke zsys_runtime_probe_leaves_smoke verifies the caller-visible CPU-class probe path remains plausible on the runtime CPU.
